longform.headline: The runway moves through the cloud
longform.opening: In March 2020, Shanghai Fashion Week moved through Tmall—and presentation met transaction.

sections.heading: Then
sections.copy: Alibaba’s first-party record says the March 2020 edition moved online through Tmall as a response to COVID-19, with livestreamed presentations and commercial features.

sections.heading: Now
sections.copy: Tmall’s commerce infrastructure joined presentation and transaction, but the company account is not independent proof of audience quality, neutrality or long-term preservation.

sections.heading: Next—and the limit
sections.copy: No permanent future cloud, streaming or commerce supplier stack is inferred from the 2020 partnership.

longform.closing: Shanghai Fashion Week is not one technology. It is a chain of permissions that turns recognition into circulation and circulation into memory.
